name: mixed_external1.k
model:
import java lang.Math
import python math

class MixedExternalTest {
  javaResult:Real
  pythonResult:Real
  input:Real

  req input = 1.6E1

  req javaResult = Math.sqrt(input)

  req pythonResult = math.sqrt(input)

  req javaResult = 4E0

  req pythonResult = 4E0

  req javaResult = pythonResult
}

main:MixedExternalTest
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((MixedExternalTest (mk-MixedExternalTest (javaResult Real)(pythonResult Real)(input Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-MixedExternalTest (sel-MixedExternalTest MixedExternalTest))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-MixedExternalTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-MixedExternalTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-MixedExternalTest ((this Ref)) MixedExternalTest
  (sel-MixedExternalTest (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-MixedExternalTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-MixedExternalTest this)
)

; =======================================
; === External Function Declarations: ===
; =======================================

; Uninterpreted functions for external (Java) calls
(declare-fun lang_Math_sqrt (Real) Real)
(declare-fun py_math_sqrt (Real) Real)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------------
;   Getters for class MixedExternalTest:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- getters for MixedExternalTest.javaResult: ---

(define-fun MixedExternalTest!javaResult ((this Ref)) Real
  (javaResult (deref-MixedExternalTest this))
)

; --- getters for MixedExternalTest.pythonResult: ---

(define-fun MixedExternalTest!pythonResult ((this Ref)) Real
  (pythonResult (deref-MixedExternalTest this))
)

; --- getters for MixedExternalTest.input: ---

(define-fun MixedExternalTest!input ((this Ref)) Real
  (input (deref-MixedExternalTest this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-MixedExternalTest (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

;   Invariant for class MixedExternalTest:
; ------------------------------------------

(declare-const const-1-MixedExternalTest MixedExternalTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun MixedExternalTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MixedExternalTest!input this) 16.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (MixedExternalTest.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

(define-fun MixedExternalTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MixedExternalTest!javaResult this) (lang_Math_sqrt (MixedExternalTest!input this)))
)

(assert (! (MixedExternalTest.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun MixedExternalTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MixedExternalTest!pythonResult this) (py_math_sqrt (MixedExternalTest!input this)))
)

(assert (! (MixedExternalTest.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

(define-fun MixedExternalTest.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MixedExternalTest!javaResult this) 4.0000000000000000)

(assert (! (MixedExternalTest.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

(define-fun MixedExternalTest.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MixedExternalTest!pythonResult this) 4.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (MixedExternalTest.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun MixedExternalTest.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MixedExternalTest!javaResult this) (MixedExternalTest!pythonResult this))
)

(assert (! (MixedExternalTest.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-MixedExternalTest const-1-MixedExternalTest))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-MixedExternalTest () MixedExternalTest
  (mk-MixedExternalTest 4.0 4.0 16.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (lang_Math_sqrt (input (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))))))
  (= (javaResult (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (py_math_sqrt (input (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))))))
  (= (pythonResult (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (pythonResult (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))) 4.0))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-MixedExternalTest a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (input (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))) 16.0))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (javaResult (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1)))
   (pythonResult (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (javaResult (sel-MixedExternalTest (select heap 1))) 4.0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-MixedExternalTest (mk-MixedExternalTest 4.0 4.0 16.0))))
(define-fun py_math_sqrt ((x!0 Real)) Real
  4.0)
(define-fun lang_Math_sqrt ((x!0 Real)) Real
  4.0)
